verdict.rationale: Intel documents an official Gaudi software stack to build against: a Docker image, native PyTorch integration for training and inference, DeepSpeed and distributed-training support, vLLM/SGLang inference, FP8/INT4 quantization, model serving, and API references with code samples. Community comments question custom-kernel programmability and Nvidia's toolchain lead, but they do not contradict that this official SDK stack exists. Missing for 10: the evidence is mostly doc headings without in-depth API detail, there is no independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience, and no documented low-level kernel/ISA reference (which users explicitly asked for).
